topInterview.title: INTERVIEW
topInterview.content: Tim ’24 has always liked to draw, as he started his artistic endeavors with coloring books. Soon enough, coloring books became doodles and doodles developed into drawings. There was a time period where Tim stopped drawing, and he sometimes wondered what his art might look like today if he stuck with art. Despite this, he is happy with the pieces he currently creates. Tim’s favorite aspect of drawing is how it allows him to convert his imagination into tangible images. He expressed how “there is something truly special about moving an image from mind to page.”
